description: This file configures Vitest testing framework for extension diffs, defining helper functions to load include patterns from environment variables and creating a scoped Vitest configuration with specific settings.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include file patterns from environment variables, defaulting to process.env if no environment object is provided.

methods.name: export function createExtensionDiffsVitestConfig( createExtensionDiffsVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates and returns a scoped Vitest configuration object with specific patterns, directory, environment, and setup files.
